blocks.text: Lucy Letby - Examination-in-chief day 3: Babies F, G, H & I
CONTENTS
MS LUCY LETBY (continued)
Examination-in-chief by MR MYERS (continued)
Monday, 15 May 2023
(In the presence of the jury)
MS LUCY LETBY (continued)
Examination-in-chief by MR MYERS (continued)

Ms Letby, you were last giving evidence on 5 May, we're now the 15th. I just want to bring us up to speed. There have been delays for good reason, delays that are unavoidable, but over this period you've been waiting to continue, haven't you?
blocks.speaker: MR MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: All right. And just so everyone can understand the position, you haven't spoken with your legal representatives over the period we've been waiting, have you?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: That of course includes me. Just so we all understand, in the normal course of events, and this is no different, a witness isn't allowed to speak with legal representatives once they start to give evidence. Certainly a defendant doesn't in Ms Letby's position.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So we're picking up really where we finished 10 days ago, aren't we; yes?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: All right. So just tune in and get comfortable, if it's at all possible where you're sitting, Ms Letby, to do that, all right? I want you to listen carefully, but we'll take this steadily as we get going again, all right? Are you listening to me?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Keep your voice up and look at the ladies and gentlemen when you're answering questions and we'll take our time with it.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I'm going to bring us back to where we were with [Baby F], which is count 6, ladies and gentlemen, and we were looking at that when we were last here.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: [Baby F], of course, was the twin of [Baby E]. All right? Born on 29 June 2015 at 17.54, 29 weeks and 5 days' gestation, and he weighed 1.434 kilograms.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: We're not going to go over everything that we looked at when we dealt with [Baby F], but what I am going to do is just remind ourselves, and I'll ask you if you can look at this too, ladies and gentlemen, of that chart with the blood sugars so we know what we're dealing with.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: We should know where that is now as we had a practice run at this on the 5th. It should be behind divider 5 in jury bundle 1, so I'm going to ask if you can follow what we're looking at, Ms Letby. I know it's me talking to start with just to bring us back to where we were.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: (Pause)
In [Baby F]'s case, Ms Letby, as we all know, from about 1.54 am on 5 August, he had low blood glucose and that continued through until about 19.00 hours that day.

Just to remind us, we'll look at the chart, a sample of blood taken at 17.56 that day returned an insulin reading of 4,657 picomoles per litre and a C-peptide of 169 picomoles per litre. You will remember, and the jury will remember, that that ratio is out. That's far too high insulin for naturally occurring insulin, we're told, and therefore that's what we're looking at.

Let's just look at the chart, Ms Letby, if you just look at that with me, please. Let's look from 5 August to remind ourselves of the figures. At 01.54 in the morning, blood glucose was at 0.8, which as we know is a low reading.
Just dealing with what's on the chart, at 02.55 it was at 2.3, but we know, and we'll return to this, there had been a bolus of dextrose given to [Baby F] in between those two readings.

At 04.02, it was down to 1.9. At 5 o'clock in the morning it was up to 2.9, but again there had been a bolus of dextrose given in between those readings. At 08.09, 1.7, which is low again. 10 o'clock, 1.3.
The TPN was stopped at 18.55 and dextrose simply was run through. At 19.00 it was up to 2.5, the blood glucose. At 21.17, 4.1.
So we're going to look at what happens with the bags as far as you can tell us, Ms Letby, over this period.
I should say [Baby F], we established this also, received care from you before this period and also, if you remember, afterwards. You looked after him on other dates, didn't you?
Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: All right. Let's have a look at the bags. I'm going to ask if we can put on the screen, please, tile 17. This is a chart for the TPN bags that we don't have in paper, ladies and gentlemen, but it's where the TPN bags start when we're following them with [Baby F]. If we can open that, thank you.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I'm going to ask if we can take a look at the whole document first so we know what we're dealing with and then we can go and look at the detail.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So this is the sheet we're looking at and it starts with 1 August and if we keep in mind that 5 August is the date that we are focusing on.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Let's have a look at the first entry, if we could, for day 4, please, Mr Murphy. And you take a look, Ms Letby.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Take a moment to have a look there. This is dated 1 August. First of all, can we see your signature anywhere in this section of the form?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, for the lipid.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: For the lipid. Does the mouse work, the one that's just by you there? Do you want to see how you get on with that? Point to where your signature is. That's your signature? Thanks, Ms Letby.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Are you able to tell us in summary what you signed for, what this represents on 1 August?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So that is starting a lipid infusion.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And we know that because across on the left-hand side it's got "lipid" on that line, hasn't it?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: What time did that lipid infusion start that you signed for?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: 00.20 on the 2nd.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So that's what we have on the next to last column on the right-hand side?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And we can see, going right of that, it says "3 August 15, 00.10"; what does that tell us?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's the time that that infusion was taken down and discarded.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So would that box be filled in when that infusion is taken down?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, only once it's been taken down.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So what does that tell us about when it was taken down then when we look at that box?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It was taken down at 00.10 hours on the 3rd and that's because lipid only lasts 24 hours.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: All right. Yours isn't the only signature in the box.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Why is there someone else who signed?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Because myself and the other signature are the ones that have drawn up that lipid and commenced it (overspeaking) need two signatures.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right, two signatures. Going left of there, we've got the date, we know that, 2 August, and then a signature.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Who is it that signs the box where it says "prescribed by"? Whose role --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's the doctor who's written the prescription.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Thank you. That lipid was started at 00.20 on 2 August.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Was there already a TPN bag up at that point?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, there was.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: How do we know there was already a TPN bag up at that point?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: The column above is referencing the TPN and it says a continuing 48-hour bag.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Is that your writing?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It is, yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Was that 48-hour bag eventually changed?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes. So if we look on the end column it was changed at the same time as the lipid syringe on 03/08.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right, at 00.10. Is there a significance in these timings round about midnight when it comes to the changing of bags or syringes?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Midnight is the time that we tend to change our fluids.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So that's standard practice for it to be around midnight.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So that's why we tend to see times around midnight for this?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's right, yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Thank you very much. If we move down, please, Mr Murphy, to what's down as day 5, 2 August 2015.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Thank you. We can see days 5 and 6, as they're put here.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Let's look at 2 August. Have you signed for anything on the Babiven line for 2 August?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: What have you signed for?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I've signed for the Babiven and for the lipid syringe.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And somebody else has co-signed with you?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: What happened with the TPN, the Babiven? What are you signing to show?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I'm signing to show that a new bag of TPN has been commenced on 3/8 at 00/10.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Does that follow on from the one that was above it that we saw that finished --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: -- on 3 August? So this is continuing?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: This is a new bag. So it's following -- the bag was taken down in the box we've just looked at and this is the new TPN and new lipid.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And that's what those two entries refer to, TPN and then lipid?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So both starting now on 3 August at 00.10?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: How long is a TPN bag meant to last for?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: TPN bags last 48-hourly (sic).
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And the lipid, is that meant to last a particular time?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So that's what's going on on 2 August. Looking below that, someone's entered something in error and scrubbed that out; is that correct?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So the next item we come to is at day 6, which is at tile 147 and we do have this in paper if you want to follow it, ladies and gentlemen. I'll let you know when I suggest we definitely need to go there, but if you want to follow it, it's in paper form in divider 6 of jury bundle, but we're putting it up on the screen. And that's divider 6 of jury bundle 2, but it's on the screen in any event.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Looking at day 6 then, 3 August 2015, we know that on the 2nd, just after midnight, you'd signed for a bag of TPN that was hung up. So what's happening on the TPN line for 3 August?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: This bag is now 24 hours old which means it doesn't need changing so I'm signing to say it's a continuing bag that's running.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So that's your signature where it says "given by"; is that correct?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: But you've not actually given anything as it happens at that point?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No, that's why it's a single signature because nothing new has been started. It's me confirming that the bag is the same bag that was running the day before.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Is that why it says "Continuing 48-hour bag"?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And the column on the right-hand side that says "Time and date finished", what's that telling us?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So that's the time that this TPN bag was discontinued.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right, thank you. Are you able to help us with what's happened where it says on the next line down, day 7, the next box down, 4 August 2015, can you help us with what's happened where we see various things but then a line put through it?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So that is -- the first prescription has been crossed through and re-prescribed by the doctor because in the top box the baby's receiving milk but in the bottom column it isn't, so the prescription's had to be changed.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Can you explain what you mean by that a little more?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: You can use the mouse if you need to point things out to us.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: This signature here (indicating) is myself and another nurse to say that a TPN bag was started on 05/08 at 00.25 and lipid was not required because the baby was receiving enteral feeds, which we can see in the enteral column here. So what we notice in the prescription below is the baby is no longer having milk feeds, therefore lipid is needed to be prescribed and therefore it has had to be crossed through above and rewritten on the next prescription.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: The one that's crossed out was done on the basis that the baby would receive -- that [Baby F] would receive an enteral milk feed?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, and therefore did not require lipid --
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: -- which is why it says "not required", but something has changed and he is now requiring lipid, which means the prescription needs to be rewritten.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So what we have at day 7 on the bottom that we can see, without the line through it, is the prescription that was actually followed; is that right?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Let's look at that one. We can see signatures and we can see a time on the right-hand side, the box to the right for the TPN and it says 00.25 -- what does that say, what's the date?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: The 5th.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: 5 August 2015. Can you tell us, first of all, what's happened there?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: A new TPN bag has been started.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: When was that TPN bag hung?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: On the 5th at 00.25.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Did that replace the one that had been there in fact --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It's the same bag. So the TPN bag is the same in both, it's the same bag in both of these prescriptions.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It's just that the bottom, this one here (indicating), is now a lipid infusion that's starting at a later time of 3 am.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So where we see the time starting at 00.25 for 5 August, that corresponded with the entry at the top --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, it does.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: -- if we just look at the top of this page, for where it says "Time and date finished".
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: If we just look at the top right-hand box again, can you see there, ladies and gentlemen, that bag was timed as finished at 00.25 on 5 August. So this bag replaced that?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Let's scroll down again to day 7, please. How many nurses were involved in hanging that bag?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Two.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: That's why there's two signatures?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's right.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And underneath that, can you tell us what's happening where it's got a reference to lipid?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: In which one, sorry?
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: On the same -- on 4 August 2015 we can see a line for lipid. Could you just tell us what that tells us when you --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: The one that's crossed through?
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: No, the one for day 7 that isn't crossed through.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: So that is two signatures to start a lipid syringe.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: It's not my signature but it's two members of staff who have started a lipid infusion at 03.00.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: I'm going to ask if we can go next -- pause for a moment because, of course, we know from the chart we looked at earlier that at 01.54, so an hour and 25 minutes after this bag had been hung, [Baby F]'s blood glucose had dropped to 0.8.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: You're aware of that, Ms Letby?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: When you gave evidence last time I asked you about what's been said with regard to the insulin and since we're dealing with it now I'll ask you again: is there anything that you did or that you know of that accounts for a drop in blood sugar at that time?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: When we looked at the chart we saw that between 1.54 and 2.55, if you have the chart you can refer back to it, ladies and gentlemen, there was an increase in the blood sugar in fact. Let's just look at how that happens.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Could we put up tile 139, please, Mr Murphy?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Scroll down, please, to 5 August, down towards the bottom. We can see at 2.55 the blood sugar has increased to 2.3. Can you see that, Ms Letby?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: I'm going to show you another tile and then ask you a question about it. That's the change in blood sugar.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Can we look at tile 191 next, which is a prescription.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: If we look four lines down, can you see we have an entry at 2.05 on 5 August?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Can you tell us what's happened there, please?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That is a 10% dextrose bolus that has been given, so 3ml of dextrose.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We know the blood sugar has risen by 2.55 --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: -- when we looked at the blood glucose.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We know, also recorded, that increase of blood glucose between 4.02 and 5 o'clock in the morning from 1.9 to 2.9. Looking at this chart, can you see anything that could account for why it is that the blood glucose increases for [Baby F] between 4.02 and 5 o'clock that morning?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes. So he's received another dextrose bolus at 04.20.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Could you move the cursor, if you would, so we can see where you're talking about? All right. Thank you. So are you identifying the line for us, Ms Letby? It'll respond now or should do.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No, it's not.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: (Pause)
Here at 04.20 (indicating).
Right. So that's a dextrose bolus that's received by [Baby F] between the readings at 4.02 and 5 o'clock?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: When the blood glucose increases?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Had you been working the night shift on this particular day or night?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: So what time would your shift had ended?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: 8 am.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right. Would you have concluded on the unit at that time?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Around that time, depending on when I finished handover, but yes, around that time.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Just keeping that in mind, can we please go next to tile 261, which we also have in paper, ladies and gentlemen, at page 3144 for anyone who's following it in paper.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I'd like us to look at the entry for day 8, the top box, for 5 August 2015. Just make sure we can all see that. Were you responsible for the care of [Baby F] at this time when we come to 5 August?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No, I wasn't.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: By "this time" I'm looking at an entry that says 12.00; can you see that?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We can all see that. Your shift had concluded that morning?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's right.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Looking at what we can actually see for the TPN bag, which is the top line that says "Babiven", can you tell us what has happened at or about 12.00 on this particular day?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes, so at midday on the 5th a new bag of TPN and lipid has been prescribed and signed for by two nurses.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Right. So the two nurses are in the column headed "Given by"; is that right?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: That's not your signature on any of them?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And the time that this was started?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's 12 midday on the 5th.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: It's got in brackets something that says "new long line"?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: By way of reminding us all, the ladies and gentlemen of the jury may recall, than [Baby F]'s line had been identified as tissuing during that morning.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: This is just reminding us of the evidence. The TPN was stopped for a period and Nurse Shelley Tomlins told us how the line and the bag were changed.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: If a line tissues and it's necessary to change the bag, what would you change as part of that procedure?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Standard practice is that everything would be discarded and you would start again with everything: new fluids, lines, everything would be new.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And you say that's standard, why is that standard practice?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Because the TPN is sterile, so the moment that you disconnect it from a line or stop it running, it's therefore no longer sterile. So practice is that once you've broken that line, you've disconnected it or you have to stop it, you would discard that and start again.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We've heard the evidence about how that happened from the nurses dealing with this.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: If we just look for a moment -- and I'll ask Mr Murphy to take us to tile 200 -- at the entry on the left-hand side for 11.00 or thereabouts. We can see the timing and see what's been signed for down at the bottom in the text.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It's got here a signature at the bottom of "SAT".
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Do you know whose initials they are?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: That's Shelley Tomlins.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Shelley Tomlins?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And what has she signed that has happened at this time?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: A new long line has been inserted into [Baby F] at this point.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And that's together with the change of TPN?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We know that even after that, the blood glucose levels remain low?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And they remain low until about 7 o'clock that evening.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Do you know why they remain low even after there has been a line and bag change?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: But at this point is this the same bag that you had hung up at midnight or just after midnight that morning?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No, it isn't.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And is it the same line?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: It's not, no.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: We can take that down, Mr Murphy, thank you.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: We've seen how on a later date or dates you continued to care for [Baby F] when you were back on the unit --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: -- is that correct? And no issues are identified then --
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: -- that you're asked for account for?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: I just want to ask you something about Facebook searches at this point. We saw from the schedule that between June 2015 and June 2016, there are 2,381 Facebook searches conducted.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Just to remind us, you'd looked for [Mother of Babies E & F] nine times between 6 August 2015 and 10 January 2016.
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Yes.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And [Father of Babies E & F] on one occasion in October 2015. Why did you search for [Mother of Babies E & F] or put her details into Facebook?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: Searching people on Facebook is something I would do.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Quite often [Mother of Babies E & F] was on my mind following [Baby E] and [Baby F]. If somebody came into my mind, that's what I would do, I'd just search their name.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: Does that just go for people at work or does it apply to people elsewhere?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No, it could be anyone.
blocks.speaker: LETBY

blocks.text: And does it apply just to babies on this indictment?
blocks.speaker: MYERS

blocks.text: No.
